behavior: Real target-thread CPU clocks replace the Darwin CLOCK_MONOTONIC fallback. Sleep/queue waits no longer consume CPU budget. Darwin send rights are retained for clock lifetime and deallocated. Explicit raw-clock overload remains supported.
threshold_policy: Original 5ms accuracy margins and 20ms limits unchanged. No QoS changes, polling changes, or wall-time extrapolation adopted.
remote_sample_limit: Observed Mach sample lag versus target self CPU up to 5007000ns; no public alternate flavor in this SDK supplies a qualified improvement.
resolution: Historical failed candidate retained. Darwin precise self-signal sampling and critical timer qualification are recorded in cpu-accounting-validation.json.
